description.ja: 2025年9月4日公開。Gemma 3ベースの埋め込みモデル。MTEB Multilingual 500M以下カテゴリで1位。768次元（Matryoshka: 128-768）の埋め込みベクトル出力。QAT（Quantization-Aware Training）で200MB未満のRAMで動作。100+言語対応。オンデバイス検索・RAGに最適。
description.en: Released September 4, 2025. Gemma 3-based embedding model. #1 in MTEB Multilingual sub-500M category. Outputs 768-dimensional embeddings (Matryoshka: 128-768). Runs on sub-200MB RAM with QAT (Quantization-Aware Training). Supports 100+ languages. Optimal for on-device search and RAG.

specs.architecture: Gemma 3 base, Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), Matryoshka Representation Learning, 768-dim embeddings

description.ja: 軽量埋め込みモデル。QATで200MB未満のRAMで動作。MTEB Multilingual 500M以下で1位。
description.en: Lightweight embedding model. Runs on sub-200MB RAM with QAT. #1 in MTEB Multilingual sub-500M.
